title: RouterOS 7.18 changelog - IPv6 FastPath, VXLAN offloading, package management and more!
description:
Some long awaited changes have come with RouterOS version 7.18. We finally have IPv6 FastPath and FastTrack, VXLAN hardware offloading, improved package management, containerizaiton improvements and more!

0:00 IPv6 FastPath and FastTrack
0:21 Improved package management
0:52 Container changes
2:11 SWAP for low RAM
2:28 file print recursive and relative
2:58 Full BTRFS support with ROSE
3:29 VXLAN hardware offloading

title: ROSE: Advanced storage in RouterOS
description:
The MikroTik ROSE (RouterOS Enterprise) package adds data center functionality to RouterOS - for supporting disk monitoring, improved formatting, RAID, rsync, iSCSI ,NVMe over TCP, NFS. This functionality currently is supported on arm, arm64, x86 and tile platforms.

This vide is part one in the series.

port

For those who don't know, our best friends are LMT, the leading mobile operator in Latvia. They put a Chateau in every home here. We took all that and created a single device that should satisfy 9 out of 10 households. The new default router, the new standard, the equilibrium. First stop, the raw computing power. At the end of the day, these are tiny specialized computers. A powerful CPU is important. So many homes struggle with advanced, no, even basic stuff, like encrypted VPN tunneling for secure remote work, because their router has a joke for CPU. Not the Chateau. It features a powerful modern ARM CPU with not one, not two, but four cores, and the right amount of RAM to support it. As it turns out, there are countless scenarios when you might want that extra speed or reliability of Ethernet cables. It's even better to have good options. So, we added 5 gigabit Ethernet ports, just for good measure. Data shows that you guys always find a good use for Ethernet. While the future is definitely wireless, it's always good to have a backup plan. But let's stay on the wireless topic for now. Chateau features powerful built-in LTE antennas and the option to connect your own external LTE antennas. That's very useful if the LTE tower is too far or you need to bypass some obstacles without moving the router to where placed. My prediction? Most of you won't ever need to connect external antennas. The built-ins are good. But like I said, always nice to have good options. With Chateau, you'll never be out of options. Finally, the built-in LTE category 6 modem. Mobile network access points can get pretty expensive because of the built-in LTE modems. So, one way to keep the cost down is to stop paying for more speed than you actually need. If you took your phone out right now and did a speed test, what would it say? Well, it depends on the location, how crowded it is, where's the cell tower and so on. But our data suggests that throughout the day, the absolute majority of mobile users doesn't see speeds above 300 megabits per second. And guess what? That's more than enough for most users. For example, if you were to stream 4k movies, what would be the minimum required speed? Around 50 megabits. So, trust me, 300 megabits is still a solid speed in 2023 for most use cases. This LTE modem has one very cool feature - carrier aggregation. It allows using multiple LTE bands at the same time, automatically. That's a huge advantage when there are a lot of mobile users in the area. It offers better responsiveness in a crowded environment and higher efficiency for weaker signal situations in the countryside. We have seen internet speeds doubling in rural areas after switching to carrier aggregation, so there's absolutely no need to wait for cable network expansions. To sum things up, our Chateau gives you options. It gives you raw power to utilize your connection to the maximum. And the coolest part, if you choose MikroTik, you're getting the only product that adapts your needs at all times. Don't want to mess with configurations and learn networking? No worries. Use our handy mobile app or let the mobile operator handle everything. We'll get to that in a moment. On the other hand, if you become interested in networking, our software gives you absolute freedom. It's like a "choose your own adventure" sandbox, where the only limit is your imagination. That's why our devices are perfect for the most diverse households, from regular people who won't touch any settings, to professional system administrators, engineers, and everyone in between. And let me give you an example. I've seen my colleagues controlling their home network through the Telegram app with the help of some bot. Can you do that on those boring default routers that your mobile operator give you now? I don't think so. So once again, it's all about the options. The freedom to do anything, when, and how you have envisioned. It can be as simple or as complex as you wish. With MikroTik, you can make the choice. You can be free. Your network, your rules. And the Chateau LTE 6 kit is the perfect balanced, cost-effective doorway to your new life of excellent networking. So by now, I'm hoping that you need and want the Chateau. And how do you actually get it? The fastest way would be to simply buy it. But in most countries, the mobile operators nowadays offer free routers with their home network contracts. I think we all deserve to simply have better default routers that our mobile operators bundle with the contracts, right? Usually I would say contact your MikroTik distributor at the end of the video. But this time, ask your mobile operator if they can give you a Chateau like the LMT does in Latvia. Because that's how everyone wins, including the mobile operator. So here are top three reasons why your mobile operator will want to make the switch. First, reliable, smooth cooperation.

We're based in the European Union. We have a transparent supply chain, reputable partners for all components. MikroTik is all about predictable long-term partnership. We design our own prototypes, make our own software, assemble and test devices right here in Riga. Customization.

title: MikroTik product news: The L009 series
description:
Prices starting as low as $119!
Time to upgrade your RB2011 setups! L009 offers more features & better performance for the same low price! This product line is 2-4 times faster than RB2011, it has a modern dual-core ARM CPU with container support, an innovative enclosure that allows mounting up to four routers in a single 1U space, more RAM, PoE, and 2.5G SFP support.

segments.transcript: The legendary RB2011 product line has provided affordable, flexible and powerful connectivity for over a decade. In fact, it was our very first router with SFP. As the name suggests, we wanted to release it in 2011. But you know, good things come to those who wait. So we released it in 2012. More than a decade has passed. Finally, it is time for an upgrade. But don't worry. All the key elements and features are still there, only better. We've also managed to keep the low, low price. And we've kept your favorite color red. Dear friends, here it is. The perfect RB2011 upgrade. The L009. The first thing you might notice is the sleek form factor. Not only is it smaller than the 2011, the new case itself acts as a massive heatsink. So you can enjoy impressive performance with excellent cooling and blissful silence. Speaking of performance, don't let the size or the low price fool you. This device is a massive upgrade over the RB2011 in so many ways. First of all, we have a modern dual core ARM CPU. It offers significant improvement when it comes to routing and filtering,

complex firewall rules, IPsec hardware encryption, and all sorts of advanced routerized features. Modern ARM CPU architecture provides significant advantages over the older MIPS architecture CPUs. Like for example, it allows using all the latest Linux kernel features. We've run some tests in RouterOS version 7.8, and the L009 dominated its predecessor. Different packet sizes, various setups, fast path routing, or complex bridge filters, it doesn't matter. The L009 is up to four times faster than

the RB2011 in most cases. And you know what else is four times larger? The RAM. The DDR3L memory is faster than the previous DDR2SD RAM. By the way, there's also a full-sized USB port, so you can always add your own storage. Along with the ARM CPU, it is perfect for your container projects. Or you can use the USB to add an LTE modem of your choice. As it is often in the case of with MikroTik, only your imagination is the limit here. Now, let's take a look at the ports. Quick command line setup for NextDNS: 

/tool fetch url=https://curl.se/ca/cacert.pem
/certificate import file-name=cacert.pem
/ip dns set servers=
/ip dns static add name=dns.nextdns.io address=45.90.28.0 type=A

/ip dns static add name=dns.nextdns.io address=2a07:a8c0:: type=AAAA

/ip dns set use-doh-server=“https://dns.nextdns.io/fe4232” verify-doh-cert=yes

Redirect DNS queries to router: 

/ip firewall nat add chain=dstnat action=redirect protocol=tcp dst-port=53 
/ip firewall nat add chain=dstnat action=redirect protocol=udp dst-port=53 

Documentation link: 

https://help.mikrotik.com/docs/display/ROS/DNS

With 10 ports, a powerful CPU, and a rugged case, netFiber 9 is a real bargain that will make your network management so much easier!

segments.transcript: Hi! My name is Rūdolfs and today we are looking  at the brand new cAP XL ac. No, it’s not a   smoke detector. It’s a powerful wireless  access point that you put on your ceiling.  Why would you want to put a router on your  ceiling? Well, there are several reasons. First   of all, signal loss. Usually, you have to worry  about all kinds of obstacles. TV, for example,   with its metal casing, motherboard and so on,  it can act as a huge net. Catching some of your   wireless signal like a greedy spider. Ceiling  access points don’t have this problem – they   rise above all the obstacles on the floor. Then there is the issue of access. Perhaps,   you are managing the network in a crowded  public space. Devices go missing. Or get   tampered with. Or maybe, you have hyperactive  children that keep resetting the router.   Either way – the ceiling will save you! Now, as you can see, the device itself is pretty   sleek. The low profile attracts less unwanted  attention. Your clients, guests, or colleagues   won’t even notice the cAP on your ceiling. But  they will definitely notice the blazing fast   wireless connection. Across all the premises. Here’s the thing. Compared to the previous cAP   models, this device allows increasing the covered  area by up to 100%! How? Well, we designed a new   dual-band antenna. Much bigger than the previous  ones. Higher sensitivity as well. And we also
installed a built-in reflector for an even better  signal. A powerful Qualcomm quad-core CPU ties

all this together to deliver amazing performance. The radio supports repeater mode, but standard   cable extensions are also an option for larger  buildings. That’s why we included two Gigabit   Ethernet ports. With PoE input on the first port  and passive PoE output on the second port. So you

can use PoE to power not only the cAP, but also  any other devices. IP cameras, network switches,   additional access points. The list goes on. In the center, you can see a customizable mode   button. By default, it is used to turn off all  lights. You don’t want a disco on your ceiling,

right? It’s fine if you do, who am I to judge?  Anyway, this button can be configured to launch   any RouterOS script. For example, you  can send an e-mail notification with a   press of a button. Or launch a self-destruct  command to reset the network configuration,   if you’re the office Bond villain or something. One last thing. Obviously, you don’t need a ladder   to configure the cAP – you can use Winbox  or connect directly through your browser.   But if you’re looking for even easier  ways to configure your MikroTik devices,   take a look at our Home App. My colleague Liene  has a really nice video on that, go check it out!   With the Home App any beginner can get started in  a few super-simple steps. Using only their phone.  If you have any questions – feel free to ask in  the comment section, our Twitter or Facebook page.   Contact your MikroTik distributor  today to get the new cAP XL ac   as soon as possible. Thanks  for watching, see you soon!

Flexibility. And customization options.   The neat and minimal design comes as a bonus. Let’s start with the customization options.   We have the experience of working with  mobile operators. title: MikroTik product news: KNOT gateway
description:
The KNOT is an IoT Gateway for the most versatile and cost-effective setups. KNOT can monitor onboard GPIOs, convert Modbus protocol to TCP, and even forward Bluetooth packets to TCP/IP network via HTTPS and MQTT.

KNOT features so many protocol support and connectivity options: 2.4 GHz wireless, Bluetooth, 2x 100 Mbps Ethernet ports with PoE-in and PoE-out, Micro-USB. Maximum convenience at the lowest cost!

PDF brochure: https://mt.lv/KNOT

segments.transcript: Hi, I am Valters from MikroTik. Let’s talk about Internet-of-things!   You have already seen our devices for  LoRa. We have brought the cost-effective   and flexible MikroTik approach to the IoT  world. Now it is time for the next step. KNOT is our IoT Gateway. It uses very low-bandwidth  and low-cost cellular connection for   IoT. Narrow Band and CAT-M. It is supported by  many mobile operators all over the world.   KNOT supports HTTPS and MQTT protocols  that allow sending sensor data to the   cloud or a local server. This unit is perfect for installation outside your house, in the garden or on your porch. Anywhere you need a capable wireless connection. The weatherproof case can be fixed to any wall. The opening in the back allows running the Etherner cable through the wall directly behind the unit. This way no cables are showing, and wAP attracts even less unwanted attention, blending into any environment. Use it on the ceiling, use it on the wall, you'll have the best connection of them all! I am definitely using the wAP ac in my home. I think you should give it a try too. By the way, it is available in two colours: black and white. Which one do you prefer? Let us know in the comments below. Contact your MikroTik distributors for more information.

Working in both 2.4 and 5 GHz wireless frequencies, providing wireless for client devices. It is a sector antenna. In 2.4 GHz frequency it has a beam of 90 degrees, and in 5 GHz it has a beam width of 60 degrees. It has a powerful 4-core ARM CPU, which supports IPsec hardware acceleration - to encrypt your traffic. It has 1x Gigabit Ethernet with PoE-in. It also has SFP port for 1 Gigabit fiber and you can also power it via regular jack, the power adapter is included in the box, as well as the PoE injector. It also has a USB port which you can use for LTE backup, for example. It comes with a quickMOUNT PRO mounting system You can attach it to a wall, to a pole, any structure, and then align the antenna both vertically and horizontally So, if you are building an outdoor wireless network - give mantBox a try! Contact your local MikroTik distributor for more information.

Router on a Stick y su Aplicacion para un ISP, Amilcar Antonio Cruz Sequeira (ASI Network, Honduras). description:

title: Wireless to Wireless
description: Wireless to Wireless, Payam Poursaied (Payam, Canada). Back in 2016 MikroTik added a nice and unique feature to the RouterOS and RouterBOARDs which allows utilizing "Virtual Wireless Interface" to have simultaneously two interfaces one in AP mode and the other in Station mode on a single radio. This presentation aims to review such configuration and some of the applications which are possible based on this feature and the drawbacks. One of the main applications of this solution is securing actual clients and preventing the disclosure of them by putting the nodes behind a simple and handy RouterBOARD while connecting to a wireless network..  PDF: https://mum.mikrotik.com/presentations/CA19/presentation_7065_1569599323.pdf.

title: Seguridad Proactiva con MikroTik y TeamCymru
description:
Seguridad Proactiva con MikroTik y TeamCymru, Andres Genovez (NOCTELECOM, Ecuador). En esta presentación se indicará como se puede prevenir grandes ataques infraestructura mediante UTRS de TeamCymru, con colaboración de proveedores de servicio de Internet mediante el protocolo de ruteo BGP.

En esta presentación se indicará los pasos a seguir para poder enlazar mediante sesiones eBGP con TeamCymru utilizando routers Mikrotik, cómo se configuran los filtros y que medidas adicionales se pueden tomar para mitigar este tipo de ataques..  PDF: https://mum.mikrotik.com/presentations/EC19/presentation_7188_1565813846.pdf.

title: Introducing  and Ideas in Fasttrack feature
description:
Introducing  and Ideas in Fasttrack feature , Sami Haddad (Sami Abdulrahman, Lebanon). Introducing the new and interesting feature "Fasttrack"
Ideas to take advantage of fasttrack feature .  PDF: https://mum.mikrotik.com/presentations/LB19/presentation_6676_1548664054.pdf.

title: Dude monitoring tool
description: Dude monitoring tool, Shaimaa Sharaf (Technopedia.io, Egypt). The Dude is a free application by MikroTik, which can dramatically improve the way you manage your network environment. It will automatically scan all devices within specified subnets, draw and layout a map of your networks, monitor services of your devices and execute actions based on device state changes.

title: MikroTik Security : Built-in Default Configuration
description: MikroTik Security : Built-in Default Configuration, Erick Setiawan (Maxindo Mitra Solusi, Indonesia). Discussing on RouterOS default-configuration in general, more detail in network security related section of the configuration set and additional tips afterwards..  PDF: https://mum.mikrotik.com/presentations/KH19/presentation_6541_1548340815.pdf.

VRRP, Farzad Heydari (Farzad Heydari, Vietnam). Describes the Virtual Router Redundancy Protocol (VRRP) support in RouterOS.
Virtual Router Redundancy Protocol (VRRP) provides a solution by combining number of routers into logical group called Virtual Router (VR). VRRP implementation in RouterOS is compliant to VRRPv2 RFC 3768 and VRRPv3 RFC 5798.  PDF: https://mum.mikrotik.com/presentations/VN19/presentation_6558_1548048558.pdf.

title: Using BCP to Create Layer 2 Networks Over the Internet
description: Using BCP to Create Layer 2 Networks Over the Internet, Faris Jawad (SMK IDN, Indonesia). Bridging a local area network through the internet is not a new idea. The interface of the MikroTik EOIP tunnel has made this easy for almost 18 years. One of the disadvantages of EOIP is that the endpoint IP address must be a public IP or tunnel must be built on a separate VPN tunnel, thus increasing packet overhead and adding additional configuration steps to create each tunnel. In this presentation, I will show BCP or Bridge Control Protocol, which is a method of bridging PPP tunnels, which provide Layer 2 connectivity (and when combined with L2TP), providing encryption in a single configuration step even when both devices have dynamic IP addresses.  PDF: https://mum.mikrotik.com/presentations/KH19/presentation_6561_1548331457.pdf.

Durante a apresentação serão abordados temas que auxiliam no crescimento e perpetuação do ISP, focando no planejamento necessário para alcançar a arquitetura de redes ideal com base nas RFC's, resultando em melhora do desempenho e segurança da entidade, serão demonstradas algumas soluções de mercado possíveis após implementação dos protocolos corretos e como isso influência na competitividade do mercado em cenário nacional.. title: Mikrotik Redundancy for MPLS Networks: BGP over OVPN
description: Mikrotik Redundancy for MPLS Networks: BGP over OVPN, Andrei Ivanoiu (INOVO SOLUTIONS, Romania). We have have configured and deployed an interesting setup for one of our clients that needed a failover cost-effective solution for their MPLS Networks, around 100 PoPs. We managed to deploy it with best effort internet uplinks (4G, DSL, WiMAX) & mikrotik routers that connect to HQ OVPN Mikrotik router and keep BGP sessions up over the OVPN link..  PDF: https:.

title: Access RouterOS using Multi-Factor Authentication
description:
Access RouterOS using Multi-Factor Authentication, Didiet Kusumadihardja (Didiet Kusumadihardja, Indonesia). With various data breach events happening in the world, we cannot rely solely on using username and password. Data breach is not only at the application level. Data breaches also occur in network devices such as MikroTik. We as network administrators must apply more security to the authentication of our MikroTik devices.

Didiet Kusumadihardja. Private Cyber Security Consultant with 12 years of experience in IT. Policy, Procedure, and Technical..  PDF: https:https://mum.mikrotik.com/presentations/ID18/presentation_6172_1540260014.pdf.

title: Web content filtering and log data analysis with Mikrotik routers
description:
Web content filtering and log data analysis with Mikrotik routers, Paul Greeff (LucidView, South Africa). Web content filtering on Mikrotik routers is often performed using either layer 7 filtering, DNS filtering or a combination of both. Both have their advantages and disadvantages.

We'll explore both and show how they can be implemented on a Mikrotik router and then introduce LucidView's Big Data analysis offering as an additional option.

Log data analysis is usually performed on Netflow traffic flows exported to a log analyzer. Free and paid for options are available on the Internet. We explore some options available to Mikrotik router users and how to configure the Mikrotik router to export data to a log analyzer.

We also introduce LucidView's solution to the above and how it is different and then demonstrate how to script the Mikrotik to perform content filtering, firewall blocking and Big Data log analysis on the LucidView's cloud portal.. title: El camino más corto para entender el BGP
description:
El camino más corto para entender el BGP, César Maffini Martin (Startnix Ip Europe, Spain). Abordaremos el proceso completo para que cualquier ISP pueda iniciarse como proveedor independiente. Desde obtener su propio ASN y Pool de IP, hastarconectar su red con otros proveedores y puntos neutros disponibles en España.

Para los ISP más experimentados en BGP, les ofreceremos algunas técnicas de optimización de rutas y una posible solución para mitigar ataques DDOS usando técnicas de ingeniería de tráfico.

Los temas a tratar son:

Alta en Ripe, petición de nuestro ASN y Pool de IP
Configurar BGP en Mikrotik
filtros, filtros con expresiones regulares
Posibles escenarios de conectividad ( Carrier, Multicarrier e IXP)
Ingeniería de trafico: ¿Como optimizar el tráfico?  # AntiDDOS usando BGP y Mikrotik.  PDF: https:https://mum.mikrotik.com/presentations/ES18/presentation_5859_1538946024.pdf.

title: Mikrotik in Network Operations in NZ - Learnings and Tricks
description: Mikrotik in Network Operations in NZ - Learnings and Tricks, Alexander Neilson (Neilson Productions Limited, New Zealand). Presenting a range of network operations tricks and learnings from the trenches when using public and private L2 networks in NZ. Tricks including the triple NAT to access resistive end user devices, handling provisioning errors by LFC's, and ensuring default configuration delivered to customers address the most common customer issues. The talk will also present compatibility testing with phones and the newest Mikrotik PoE Switches..  PDF: https:https://mum.mikrotik.com/presentations/NZ18/presentation_5428_1527237656.pdf.

title: DYNAFA - The Dynamic Firewall Authenticator
description:
DYNAFA - The Dynamic Firewall Authenticator, David Reeves (EIT Hawke's Bay, New Zealand).  PDF: https:https://mum.mikrotik.com/presentations/NZ18/presentation_5619_1526976443.pdf.

DYNAFA is a small project I have been working on. It is a firewall based authentication system which can leverage RouterOS scheduler and script tools, as well as address lists and packet filtering. This creates an virtually impenetrable network, which can only be unlocked with the correct sequence of packets. The correct sequences are randomized and mixed together in a way which an attacker could never reproduce, even while understand the system. They are then hard coded into the firewall rules, and those rules can be altered over time, to leave only but the smallest number of ports open to attack. This minimizes attack surface significantly ( less 0.02 % ), counters port scans and probes ( Dynamic attack surface ), counters replay attacks ( Dynamic Authentication Requirements ) stings attackers with booby-traps within the authentication surface topology ( High risks of being blacklisted ), is resource efficient ( Negative filtering ) and near impossible to crack with brute force

description:
Migracion de una red plana a red rutada con MikroTik, Alejandro Gordon (InternetWork Solution, Ecuador). El problema empienza al intentar actualizar la red y volverla escalable, se consulto con el proveedor del sistema wispro, este afirmo que es posible rutear la red, pero no es posible mantener el PPPoE para el cliente final.
La estructura de red era totalmente plana sin segmentar, extendiendo dominios de broadcast atraves de varios nodos, creando problemas en capa 2, ademas de crear lentitud en transferencia de datos..  PDF: https:.

title: VLAN in MikroTik
description:
VLAN in MikroTik, Muhammad Fathan Mubina (SMK  Madinatul Qur'an, Indonesia). You can use MikroTik RouterOS to mark these packets as well as to accept and route marked ones.

As VLAN works on OSI Layer 2, it can be used just as any other network interface without any restrictions. VLAN successfully passes through regular Ethernet bridges.

You can also transport VLANs over wireless links and put multiple VLAN interfaces on a single wireless interface. Note that as VLAN is not a full tunnel protocol (i.e., it does not have additional fields to transport MAC addresses of sender and recipient), the same limitation applies to bridging over VLAN as to bridging plain wireless interfaces. In other words, while wireless clients may participate in VLANs put on wireless interfaces, it is not possible to have VLAN put on a wireless interface in station mode bridged with any other interface.. Dynamic VPNs - Faking DMVPN Like connectivity, Welby McRoberts (Welby McrOberts, United Kingdom). As part of a "Freind2Freind" VPN set up between some friends and colleagues I've created a script that setups VPN connections (and appropriate routing peers) between the locations and handles the addition of new peers. 

In this presentation I'll go over the concept of a dynamic vpn (with some quick comparisons to DM-VPN) and how this can be achieved on a RouterOS device and what the pitfalls of a semi-public peering can be..  PDF: http://mum.mikrotik.com/presentations/UK16/presentation_3868_1479205573.pdf.

title: Keeping your rack cool with one /ip route rule
description:
Keeping your rack cool with one /ip route rule, Marek Isalski (Faelix Limited, United kingdom). Thousands of bots are hammering your IP addresses with brute-force password attempts, DDoS attacks, and other unwanted traffic.  Don't want the bad guys to waste CPU cycles on your servers?  Marek will explain how Faelix Limited integrated intrusion detection systems, fail2ban, FastNetMon, and other systems with some MikroTik CCRs at our network edge.

This presentation covers our experience with MikroTiks in the default-free zone, common abuse traffic patterns, honeypots, and some ideas how to help black-hat SEO "comment spam" consultants transition to a more ethical form of employment..  PDF: http://mum.mikrotik.com/presentations/UK16/presentation_3885_1479296620.pdf.

title: MikroTik sebagai pelayan TV Cable sehat
description: MikroTik sebagai pelayan TV Cable sehat, Miftakhul Huda (Poltek Tegal, Indonesia). Pendidikan anak adalah pondasi yang harus diperhatikan para orang tua sedari dini yang sebaiknya para orang tua dapat mengatur waktu belajar mereka dengan ketat. Stasiun televisi saat ini banyak dan program-program yang ditawarkan tidak mengenal waktu alias 24 jam non stop serta batasan umur pemirsa yang terkadang kurang diperhatikan dalam tayangaannya. TV Cable sudah banyak digunakan untuk media pertelevisian di indonesia yang dengan sendirinya seolah dunia tak terbatas, akan lebih parah jika anak usia dini dibiarkan tanpa pengaturan waktu untuk menontonnya. Sehingga dari masalah tersebut TV Cable yang disewa perlu diatur jam-jam penggunaannya dalam rangka menjamin waktu belajar anak-anak dalam keluarga. Mikrotik adalah piranti networking yang dari service atau sistemnya terdapat VLAN dan Time Scedule dapat digunakan untuk hal tersebut. Untuk itu dalam presentasi ini akan dijelaskan pengalaman kami dalam menggunakan mikrotik Router sebagai pengatur jam penggunaan TV Cable USeeTV sehingga anak-anak dan keluarga tidak lupa waktu dalam Sholat dan Belajar dengan memanfaatkan Vitur VLAN dan Scedule mikrotik router board..

description: Social Wifi en MikroTik - Como Añadir Valor al Wifi de nuestro Cliente, Jordi Vallejo (Social And Beyond, Spain). Necesitamos herramientas para conseguir que nuestro cliente invierta en infraestructura Wifi. Hoy en día es necesario ofrecerles, unido a la infraestructura, Valor Añadido que les compense la inversión y Social Wifi está probando ser clave para estas decisiones de inversion. title: MikroTik en CPD para Circuitos de Alta Capacidad
description: MikroTik en CPD para Circuitos de Alta Capacidad, Sergio Rodríguez and Ramón Fernández (Landatel, Spain). En la actualidad, gracias a la aparición de la gama Cloud Core Router, han empezado a proliferar equipos MikroTik en diferentes Data Centers, algo que hasta ahora estaba reservado a otros fabricantes de gama alta . En esta sesión se presentará un caso de éxito en el cual se proporcionan circuitos de gran capacidad y alta disponibilidad para el transporte del tráfico de Internet en redes de backhaul..  PDF: http://mum.mikrotik.com/presentations/ES16/presentation_3935_1474466825.pdf.

title: Design and Implement VLAN Translations/Rewrites using Switches and Routers
description: Design and Implement VLAN Translations/Rewrites using Switches and Routers, Kevin Myers (IP ArchiTechs Managed Services, USA). This presentation will highlight the use cases of VLAN Translations in real world environments to include Data Center, Enterprise and Service provider/WISP. Design and implementation will be covered using RouterBoard routers and CRS switches. Verification of VLAN Translation will also be covered using the sniffer tool and Wireshark..

title: Cloud Core Router product details
description:
The Cloud Core Router is an industrial grade router with a cutting edge 36 core Tilera CPU. Unprecedented power and unbeatable performance - this is our new flagship 
device. 20 times faster than our previous top model, the Cloud Core can throughput up to 24 million packets per second, or up to 16 gigabits. This is full wire speed. 

The device comes in a 1U rackmount case, has four SFP ports, twelve Gigabit ethernet ports, serial console and a USB port. A color touchscreen displays device status, traffic graphs, or provide access to simple configuration options. 

The device has two SODIMM slots, by default it is shipped with 4GB of RAM, but has no memory limit in RouterOS, so will accept and utilize 16GB or more. 

The cloud core router is powered by RouterOS, a fully featured routing operating system which has been continuously improved for fifteen years. Dynamic routing, hotspot, firewall, MPLS, VPN, advanced quality of service, load balancing and bonding, real-time configuration and monitoring - just a few of the vast number of features supported by RouterOS. 

The cloud core router is ready for any situation, for any load.

Buy here: http://www.mikrotik.com/buy
